reply.text: That's one for how your body's telling you to adjust load, not something I can call from here — but general soreness isn't an injury, so let's talk training logic. If it's normal DOMS and strength/range feel fine, a lighter push day or just pushing the warm-up longer usually works better than skipping outright. If there's sharp pain, swelling, or it's joint-specific rather than muscle soreness, that's a doctor or physio question before you touch a bar. Want me to look at what's actually on push day so we figure out whether to run it as-is or lighten it?
